stages.title: Ms. Marvel

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aamir Khan is Muneeba's son, and she helps plan his wedding to Tyesha.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sana Ali is Aamir's grandmother, his mother's mother, who lives in Karachi. On the day of Aamir's wedding, she has a vision of the Partition train and urges Kamala and Muneeba to come see her.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aamir Khan and Tyesha Hillman are engaged and marry surrounded by the Khan family, with Aamir even joining the family dance at their reception.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Yusuf Khan is Aamir's father, and the two share a warm, joking bond. When Aamir is stressed about money, Yusuf sits him down and tells him he was brave to choose family over fear.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Aaron Davis tries to buy weapons from Herman Schultz and Jackson Brice.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Aaron Davis meets Jackson Brice to buy one of the Vulture crew's alien weapons, turning down Brice's Ultron-built blaster because he only wants something small. The deal falls apart when Spider-Man shows up.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Mac Gargan was Aaron Davis's partner until they parted ways over Gargan's dangerous nature.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Spider-Man saves Aaron Davis when a weapons deal goes wrong, then webs him to his car to question him about the Vulture's crew. Aaron gives up the location of the next sale because he wants the alien weapons off his neighborhood's streets.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Abu Bakaar holds Ho Yinsen captive and uses him as Tony Stark's translator.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Abu Bakaar is Raza's right-hand man in the Ten Rings cell that holds Tony Stark captive in Afghanistan.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Abu Bakaar holds Tony Stark captive and has him tortured to make him build a Jericho missile. Iron Man later spares him and leaves him to the people of Gulmira.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Ayesha, leader of the Sovereign, creates Adam Warlock and treats him as her son.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: When Adam Warlock attacks Knowhere to capture Rocket, Drax tackles and pummels him. Adam overpowers him with energy blasts and leaves him on the ground.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Adam Warlock hunts the Guardians for the High Evolutionary. On the Bowie, he stops War Pig from killing Gamora, but only so he can claim Rocket's capture for himself.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Groot wraps Adam Warlock in his roots when Adam attacks Knowhere, and Adam tears him apart against the buildings. Groot later rescues Adam during the fight with the High Evolutionary, and they go on to serve together on Rocket's new Guardians team.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: When Adam Warlock attacks Knowhere to capture Rocket, Mantis lunges at him, and he snaps her arm and throws her aside.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Nebula fights Adam Warlock during his attack on Knowhere and has no patience for him afterwards.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Adam Warlock attacks the Guardians on Knowhere to capture Rocket, and Quill blasts him away. In the end, Adam saves Quill from dying in open space and joins the new Guardians.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Phyla and Adam Warlock join the new Guardians of the Galaxy under Rocket's leadership.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Adam Warlock attacks Knowhere on the High Evolutionary's orders and leaves Rocket mortally wounded. After Adam redeems himself, he joins the new Guardians team that Rocket leads.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary sends Adam Warlock, the Sovereign's creation, to bring Rocket back to him. Adam later breaks with him and ends up helping the Guardians.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Agatha Harkness recruits Alice Wu-Gulliver, a protection witch, into her coven for the Witches' Road. Alice dies on the Road in an accident that Agatha causes.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Agatha Harkness babysits Billy and his twin Tommy as the nosy neighbor "Agnes" in Westview. Then she seizes the boys and chokes them with her magic to force Wanda to give up her power.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Years later Billy, now living in William Kaplan's body, follows Agatha Harkness down the Witches' Road. She tries to take his power, but in the end she gives her life for him and stays on as his ghostly guide.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Agatha Harkness, an old acquaintance, recruits Jennifer Kale into her coven for the Witches' Road. The two bicker constantly, but Jen sees the Road through to its end.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Agatha Harkness recruits Lilia Calderu, a centuries-old divination witch, into her coven for the Witches' Road. Lilia follows her to the end and gives her life to destroy the Salem Seven.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Monica Rambeau sneaks into Agatha's house in Westview, where Agatha's fake Pietro traps her.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Rio Vidal, Death herself, is Agatha Harkness's former lover. She took Agatha's son long ago, and in the end she takes Agatha too.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Agatha Harkness recruits Sharon Davis, her former Westview neighbor, as a stand-in witch for her coven on the Witches' Road.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Agatha Harkness babysits Tommy and his twin Billy as "Agnes" in Westview, then seizes the boys to force Wanda's hand.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Years later Agatha, now a ghost at Billy's side, helps him search for Tommy's lost soul and a new body to give it.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Agatha Harkness poses as the nosy neighbor Agnes in Westview while she schemes against Wanda Maximoff's family, Vision included.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Agatha Harkness poses as Wanda Maximoff's nosy neighbor Agnes in Westview to learn her secrets, then fights her for her power. Wanda wins and traps Agatha in the Agnes persona.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Damage Control's Agent Cleary questions Happy Hogan about missing Stark Industries technology after Peter Parker's identity is exposed, with Matt Murdock at Happy's side.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Agent Cleary of Damage Control detains May Parker after Peter is framed for Mysterio's death. When he questions her, May points out he cannot hold her without charges and admits she has been arrested before for protesting.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Agent Cleary interrogates MJ after Peter is framed, but she demands a lawyer and refuses to answer his questions. He warns her she is throwing away a bright future by sticking with a vigilante.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Agent Cleary interrogates Ned after Peter is framed for Mysterio's death and tricks him into admitting he has helped Spider-Man for years, which makes him an accomplice.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Agent Cleary interrogates Peter Parker after Mysterio frames him for murder.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Agent Cleary of Damage Control targets Simon Williams and plants Trevor Slattery near him to prove he has powers.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Agent Cleary uses Trevor Slattery as an informant to keep watch on Simon Williams.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Agent Cleary interrogates Zoe Zimmer about the hero who saved her at AvengerCon and suggests she faked the incident.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mack distrusts Aida from the start and warns that she will turn on them. When she does, he cuts her first body's head off with his shotgun axe, and she later traps him in the Framework.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Aida helps Holden Radcliffe break into Billy Koenig's mind for the Darkhold's location, distracting him with a vision of a puppy while they scan his memories.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Aida, Holden Radcliffe's android, first works with Quake and the team to stop Eli Morrow. She then traps Daisy's friends inside the Framework, and Daisy and Jemma Simmons go in to free them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Agent Davis helps pull Fitz out of the chamber where Aida, now the human Ophelia, attacks him. He and Piper shoot her again and again, only to watch her wounds heal.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Yo-Yo goes into the Framework to bring Mack home, and Aida starts deleting it while the two are still inside, threatening to kill them both. Yo-Yo goes on to fight Aida and her decoys in the real world.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe builds the android Aida as his assistant.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Aida turns on Radcliffe, traps him in the Framework and later kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Aida first works for S.H.I.E.L.D. as Holden Radcliffe's assistant under Director Mace. She then holds Mace captive on a submarine, replaces him with a Life Model Decoy, and traps his mind in the Framework.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Jemma distrusts Holden Radcliffe's android Aida, and she is proven right when Aida traps her friends inside the Framework. Jemma goes in to free them and then fights the newly human Aida back in the real world.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Aida is the android Holden Radcliffe builds, and Fitz helps develop her. Once she gains a human body, she becomes obsessed with him, and when he rejects her she turns on him and the team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Aida, Holden Radcliffe's android, at first helps save May's life after a ghost's touch nearly kills her. Then Aida kidnaps May, replaces her with a Life Model Decoy, and traps her mind inside the Framework.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Aida starts out as an android assistant at Phil Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D., then turns on the team and traps them in the Framework. Coulson finally destroys her by borrowing the power of the Spirit of Vengeance.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Piper fights Aida and her Life Model Decoys on May's strike team, and she helps pull Fitz out of the chamber where the newly human Aida attacks him. Coulson also trusts Piper to tell the world about Aida if he fails to stop her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: The gate Aida and Holden Radcliffe build helps bring Robbie back from between dimensions. Later Ghost Rider, who can sense the dark matter in her, returns from Hell to help S.H.I.E.L.D. take her down for good.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: The Superior joins forces with Aida and Holden Radcliffe. Once Aida gains human feelings, she turns on him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Tucker Shockley works alongside Aida for the Superior but despises her for not being human and tells her to leave. When Aida kills the Superior's men to protect Radcliffe, she spares only Ivanov and Shockley.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aisha is Hasan's wife. She leaves the Clandestines to marry him and raise their daughter Sana.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aisha is Kamala's great-grandmother, a Clandestine who left her bangle to the family. Kamala meets her in a vision of 1942 and during Partition.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aisha is Muneeba's grandmother, the Clandestine whose bangle was passed down to Kamala.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Najma, Aisha's fellow Clandestine, kills Aisha for leaving the group with the bangle.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aisha is Sana's mother. As a child, Sana is separated from Aisha during Partition, and Aisha dies protecting her.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ajak is the only Eternal who speaks with Arishem, the Celestial who created them. She turns against his plan once she learns it will destroy Earth.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Druig argues with Ajak over the Eternals' ban on stopping human wars, and he leaves the group after a massacre in Tenochtitlan.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ajak leads the Eternals, and Ikaris serves under her for thousands of years. When she turns against Arishem's plan, he betrays her by leading her to the Deviants in Alaska so that she dies before she can stop the Emergence.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: After Ikaris leaves Ajak at the mercy of the Deviants, Kro kills her and takes her powers.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ajak is Phastos' leader and friend. She comforts him after his inventions are used to destroy Hiroshima.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ajak, the Eternals' Prime, chooses Sersi to succeed her as leader and to speak with Arishem.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ajak leads the Eternals, Sprite among them, from their arrival on Earth until they part ways. Thousands of years later, Sprite, Sersi and Ikaris go to her home to warn her about the Deviants and find her dead.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ajak leads the Eternals and tries to help Thena manage her Mahd Wy'ry.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Akela Amador, forced to obey the Clairvoyant through an implant in her eye, runs Skye's van off the road while Coulson's team hunts her. Skye still argues that Akela deserves the second chance Coulson wants to give her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Jemma Simmons and Fitz hunt Akela Amador in Belarus, where she runs their van off the road while the Clairvoyant controls her. Once she is caught, Jemma numbs Akela's eye and the two scientists remove the bionic implant.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Fitz and Jemma Simmons hunt Akela Amador in Belarus, and she runs their van off the road while the Clairvoyant controls her through a bionic eye. Once she is caught, they operate to remove the eye.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Akela Amador, forced to obey the Clairvoyant, grabs a gun to kill Melinda May during a mission in Belarus, but Coulson knocks her out first. Coulson once trained Akela and rated her skills alongside May's.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson trained Akela Amador as a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. Years later he saves her from the Clairvoyant's control.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Akeya, leader of the Dora Milaje, had expelled Noni. She sends Noni after the Lion and promises her a place back in the Dora Milaje if she succeeds.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Akeya considers the Lion's theft of Wakandan artifacts treason. She sends warrior after warrior after him, and finally Noni.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: As Ronin, Clint hunts Akihiko's Yakuza in Tokyo for surviving the Snap. He cuts down his men, ignores Akihiko's plea for mercy, and kills him.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Alan Saunders and Connor Powell serve together on Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force. When Powell discovers that Saunders has been helping Daredevil, he shoots him dead and blames vigilantes.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Karen captures Alan Saunders, an Anti-Vigilante Task Force officer. He later turns against the task force and helps Daredevil.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Alan Saunders is an Anti-Vigilante Task Force officer whom Karen captures. He secretly turns against the task force and gives Daredevil a key card into Fisk's prison.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Alan Saunders serves Mayor Wilson Fisk as a hand-picked member of the Anti-Vigilante Task Force.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Ellen Brandt is an Army veteran and amputee whom Aldrich Killian recruits into his Extremis program. She becomes one of his agents and is sent to Rose Hill to cover up his trail and capture Tony Stark.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Eric Savin is Aldrich Killian's bodyguard and top Extremis soldier. Killian sends him to destroy Tony Stark's mansion and later to hijack the Iron Patriot armor and kidnap President Ellis.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Aldrich Killian's men capture James Rhodes and steal his Iron Patriot armor to abduct the President. Rhodey fights his way onto Killian's oil rig to rescue him.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Maya Hansen works for Aldrich Killian on Extremis. He kills her when she turns against him.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Aldrich Killian kidnaps Pepper Potts and injects her with Extremis, and she kills him.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Tony Stark snubs Aldrich Killian in 1999. Years later Killian plots to destroy him.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Aldrich Killian hires the struggling actor Trevor Slattery to play the Mandarin, paying him in money and drugs. Trevor fronts the fake terrorist while Killian passes off his Extremis accidents as bombings.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Vice President Rodriguez secretly works with Aldrich Killian in exchange for Extremis for his daughter.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Arnim Zola rebuilds HYDRA inside S.H.I.E.L.D. after the war, and Alexander Pierce later leads it. Zola's algorithm picks the targets for Pierce's Project Insight.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Brock Rumlow serves Alexander Pierce as a HYDRA agent inside S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Alexander Pierce uses the Winter Soldier as HYDRA's assassin, sending him after Nick Fury and Steve Rogers. When Bucky starts to remember Steve, Pierce has his mind wiped again.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Battle of New York, Alexander Pierce's STRIKE team takes Loki's scepter and sends it on to Dr. List for HYDRA's experiments.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick works alongside Alexander Pierce as one of the HYDRA leaders hidden inside S.H.I.E.L.D. He once hoped Pierce would share his faith in Hive, but found him too bloodthirsty.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jack Rollins is one of the HYDRA agents hidden in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s STRIKE team, loyal to Alexander Pierce. During the HYDRA uprising he holds the World Security Council hostage for Pierce, until Natasha Romanoff turns the tables on them.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell is one of Alexander Pierce's HYDRA agents inside S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Maria Hill serves at S.H.I.E.L.D. under Alexander Pierce until he is exposed as Hydra. She rescues Steve, Natasha and Sam from his strike teams and helps destroy his Project Insight at the Triskelion.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Alexander Pierce oversees Natasha Romanoff's work at S.H.I.E.L.D. while secretly running HYDRA. She exposes his plot by dumping S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets online right in front of him.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Alexander Pierce is Nick Fury's old friend and boss on the World Security Council. Secretly he leads HYDRA, and he orders Fury's assassination. Fury kills him.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson helps Steve Rogers stop Alexander Pierce's Project Insight.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: After Nick Fury is shot, Sharon debriefs Alexander Pierce at the Triskelion, and he assures her she did all she could. When his Hydra plot comes to light, she turns her gun on his men to stop the launch of Project Insight.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Alexander Pierce is Steve Rogers' superior at S.H.I.E.L.D. until Steve learns that Pierce secretly leads HYDRA inside the agency. Steve exposes him and brings down his Project Insight helicarriers.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Alexandra Reid leads the five founders of the Hand, Bakuto among them. She calls him back to New York to finish their plan and means to confront him over his failures with the Iron Fist.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Alexandra wants the Iron Fist to open the door to K'un-Lun's dragon bones. She hunts Danny Rand for it.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Alexandra raises Elektra from the dead as the Black Sky and keeps her as her weapon. Elektra turns on her and kills her.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Alexandra Reid leads the Hand when Jessica Jones is drawn into the fight, and orders Elektra to kill everyone protecting the Iron Fist. Jessica answers by throwing a car through the window into Elektra.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Alexandra leads the Hand and turns Elektra against Matt. He fights her alongside the Defenders.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Sowande serves Alexandra Reid, the leader of the Hand, and brings her Elektra's body so she can be reborn as the Black Sky. His death shakes the others' faith in Alexandra's leadership.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Alexandra leads the Hand, and Stick tries to stop her from using Elektra and the Iron Fist.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Alexei takes a liking to Bob Reynolds after picking the group up in the desert, and cheers when Bob is unveiled as the Sentry. When Valentina turns the Sentry against them, Alexei charges in first and is knocked into a wall, but the team ends up saving Bob from the Void together.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Alexei Shostakov idolizes Bucky Barnes as a fellow super soldier and is thrilled to fight beside him. They team up with Yelena's crew to take on Valentina and the Sentry.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Alexei Shostakov worked for Dreykov as a Soviet super soldier. Dreykov then sent him to a gulag.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Alexei rescues Ghost, Yelena and the others in his limousine as they escape Valentina, awkwardly asking Ghost whether her body parts reappear in the wrong places. They go on to fight together as the Thunderbolts.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Alexei picks up John Walker and the other O.X.E. survivors in his limo after they escape the vault, and joins them in turning on Valentina. The two end up teammates on the New Avengers.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Alexei and Melina pose as husband and wife during their undercover mission in Ohio and come to have real feelings for each other. They reunite years later at Melina's farm and help their daughters bring down the Red Room.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Alexei Shostakov posed as Natasha Romanoff's father in their undercover family in Ohio. Years later they reunite to fight the Red Room.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Alexei sees himself as the Soviet answer to Captain America and brags to fellow inmates that he once fought Steve Rogers, a story that cannot be true. He even asks Natasha whether Steve ever mentions him.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Taskmaster captures Alexei at Melina's farm and hauls him back to the Red Room. When he breaks out, she quickly gets the better of him in a brawl until Melina locks her in a cell.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Alexei admires Valentina and envies Yelena's job working for her, until he overhears Valentina plotting to get rid of Yelena while driving her limo. He then joins the team in bringing Valentina down.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Alexei Shostakov plays Yelena's father during a Soviet undercover mission in Ohio, a family she believes is real as a little girl. Years later she breaks him out of prison to help bring down the Red Room.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Alexei, now driving a limo, notices that the light inside Yelena has dimmed and keeps trying to lift her up. He rescues her crew from Valentina and fights beside his daughter on the Thunderbolts.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Alice Wu-Gulliver is the police officer who answers the car crash that puts Billy into William Kaplan's body. Years later they meet again on the Witches' Road as coven members.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Alice Wu-Gulliver is the police officer Jeff Kaplan flags down after his family's car crash.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Jennifer Kale and Alice Wu-Gulliver walk the Witches' Road together in Agatha's coven until Alice is killed on the Road.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Lilia Calderu and Alice Wu-Gulliver walk the Witches' Road together in Agatha's coven until Alice is killed on the Road.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Alice Wu-Gulliver is the police officer who answers the Kaplans' car crash. She helps Rebecca Kaplan keep her injured son still until the ambulance arrives.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Rio Vidal walks the Witches' Road with Alice Wu-Gulliver as the coven's Green Witch. When Alice dies, Rio, who is Death, comes to guide her away.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Alligator Loki hides from Alioth in the Void with Kid Loki's band of variants.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Cassandra Nova rules her corner of the Void, and Alioth is the only power there that rivals her. The storm tears into her compound and later tries to swallow her forces in the middle of their battle.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Classic Loki spends years in the Void hiding from Alioth. He finally gives his life conjuring an illusion of Asgard to distract it, so that Loki and Sylvie can enchant it.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: He Who Remains harnesses Alioth during the Multiversal War and turns the creature into the weapon that ends it. Afterward he sets Alioth to guard the Void, keeping intruders away from his Citadel.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Kid Loki rules the Void but lives in fear of Alioth, the storm-like creature that devours whatever it finds there.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Alioth nearly devours Logan in the Void, and Logan helps Cassandra Nova take it down.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Alioth, the living storm that rules the Void, nearly devours Loki when he first tries to enchant it. Loki and Sylvie later enchant Alioth together to get past it to the Citadel at the End of Time.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: After Renslayer prunes him, Mobius lands in the Void and escapes Alioth in an abandoned car. He then rescues Sylvie from the creature and backs her plan to enchant it.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: After pruning herself, Sylvie lands in the Void and is chased by Alioth, glimpsing a castle when she briefly touches its mind. With Loki's help she enchants the creature, opening the way to the Citadel at the End of Time.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Alisa Jones, Jessica's mother, is Danielle's maternal grandmother, though she dies years before Danielle is born.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Detective Eddy Costa investigates the string of killings that turn out to be Alisa Jones's work. While fleeing the police, Alisa drags Costa's partner Ruth Sunday out a window to her death.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jeri Hogarth takes on Alisa Jones's legal case after her arrest and gets her a deal that keeps her out of the Raft. Jessica later begs Jeri to delay her mother's transfer.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica is Alisa's daughter. She believes her mother died in the car crash that killed her family, then learns IGH secretly saved and changed Alisa, and the two reconnect before Trish kills Alisa.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Karl Malus saves Alisa Jones's life with his experiments and falls in love with her.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish's investigation into IGH uncovers that Jessica's mother, Alisa, is alive and behind a string of killings, and Alisa comes to blame Trish for ruining her life. Trish later shoots Alisa dead to keep her from escaping with Jessica.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Will Simpson learns that Alisa Jones may go after Trish Walker and tries to warn her. Alisa tracks him down at the Greenpoint Stages and kills him.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Classic Loki and Alligator Loki are part of the same small band of Lokis hiding from Alioth in the Void.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Alligator Loki is one of Kid Loki's closest friends in the Void. Kid Loki leads their little band and they hide out together in his bunker.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Alligator Loki is a reptilian variant of Loki living in the Void with Kid Loki's band. When Loki is pruned and lands there, the band takes him in.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: When President Loki's army ambushes the bunker, Alligator Loki bites off President Loki's hand.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Daniel Sousa personally hires Aloysius Samberly for the S.S.R.'s new Los Angeles lab. He leans on Samberly often, from testing the strange ice around Jane Scott's body to trading a slice of pie for the loan of a memory inhibitor.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Aloysius Samberly runs the SSR lab in Los Angeles and grumbles when Peggy Carter borrows his gadgets. He comes through for her anyway, building the Gamma Cannon used against Whitney Frost.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Aloysius Samberly, the SSR's lab chief in Los Angeles, has an obvious crush on Rose Roberts and keeps asking her out. On their first field assignment together, they pose as a lost married couple to get past the guards at a Roxxon warehouse.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vernon Masters orders his men to kill Aloysius Samberly, Daniel Sousa and Jack Thompson after they use the Gamma Cannon on the rift. They lock Samberly up instead, and Masters lets him go once he needs the cannon repaired.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack and Anne Weaver serve together in Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. After Mack is hurt shielding Fitz from an explosion, Weaver asks Jemma Simmons to check his injuries, and the two later work together to secure dangerous alien artifacts.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack and Trip are friends and teammates at the Playground, trading news from missions and talk about new gear. When Trip dies in the Kree city, Mack sees his death as an unfair trade for Skye's life.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack and Bobbi Morse are best friends who go undercover together in Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. for Robert Gonzales. Their bond goes back to the Iliad, where Bobbi saves Mack from the Hydra agents holding him hostage.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack helps Fitz rebuild the Overkill Device into the weapon that lets Coulson take down Carl Creel. He wants Creel dead for his part in Isabelle Hartley's death.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Years later Creel is deprogrammed, and once Mack gets to know him, he forgives him and comes to see him as a decent man.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack and Daisy Johnson become close friends on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Daisy steps down as acting Director and names Mack to lead S.H.I.E.L.D. instead, and from then on she serves under her old friend.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Mack chooses to save Daniel Sousa from the Hydra assassination that history says ended his life in 1955, pulling him onto the team. Sousa then serves under Mack, now director of S.H.I.E.L.D., as they chase the Chronicoms through time.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Agent Davis serves alongside Mack on S.H.I.E.L.D. missions. When the Spirit of Vengeance takes hold of Mack, he attacks Davis and rides off the plane on Davis' motorbike.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Davis serves under Mack once Mack becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., until Izel possesses Davis and kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Mack and Deke Shaw start out at odds in the future, but they become close friends.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Mack, now Director, rescues Deke from Sarge's squad. Once Deke proves himself by saving his friends from Izel, Mack makes him an official S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mack and Elena Rodriguez fall in love while fighting side by side.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Once Mack becomes Director, the job consumes him and he breaks up with Elena. Later he admits he was wrong, and they find their way back to each other.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mack and Coulson visit Eli Morrow in prison for answers about Ghost Rider, and later turn to him for help against the ghosts. Eli turns out to be the real threat, and Mack briefly becomes Ghost Rider himself to help bring him down.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Enoch, a Chronicom observer, sends Mack and the team into the future, where Mack wakes up and knocks out one of the guards.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Mack and Enoch become friends as Enoch travels through time with the team, and Enoch flies Zephyr One so Mack can shoot down the Project Insight rocket with the ship's missiles.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Mack befriends Flint, a young Inhuman in the future Lighthouse, and helps hide him from the Kree Watch on the Trawler. He and Yo-Yo stay behind with Flint to help the people fight back against the Kree.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Gordon raids the Iliad during Jiaying's attack on S.H.I.E.L.D., while Mack stands guard over the Terrigen crystals. When Gordon asks who he is, Mack answers that he is the guy who kills Gordon.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: In the future Lighthouse, Grill puts Mack, Yo-Yo and Coulson to work in his workshop and uses their metrics to keep them in line. When the Renewal begins, he betrays them and pins them to a wall to be killed.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Mack goes after Daisy in Romania and runs into Hellfire, who is covering Hive's kidnapping of Holden Radcliffe. James sets off explosions in the bar as they fight, and when he complains about his name, Mack suggests Blowhard.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe works with Mack and S.H.I.E.L.D. as a consultant, though Mack distrusts his work on the android Aida. Radcliffe's Framework later traps Mack in a false life.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Isabelle Hartley and Bobbi Morse save Mack and other agents from Hydra aboard the Iliad. Mack, Isabelle, and Bobbi then go undercover together in Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. for Robert Gonzales.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Director Jeffrey Mace sends Mack and Coulson to bring in Daisy, now the vigilante Quake. When the Watchdogs shoot down Mace's Quinjet in Freyer National Park, Mack takes out the mercenaries sent to kill him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack and Jemma Simmons become close friends on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: After Fitz dies, Jemma serves under Mack, now Director, while she searches space for the younger Fitz, who is still frozen out there.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Mack, Daisy, and Lance Hunter rescue Joey Gutierrez in Seattle before the ATCU can take him. As acting Director, Mack later gives the green light for Joey's first mission with the Secret Warriors.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Kasius rules the human slaves on the Lighthouse in the future, and Mack helps rally the uprising against him. In their final fight, Mack kills Kasius.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lance Hunter becomes close friends with Mack and Bobbi Morse on a mission in Dubai. When Hunter later catches the two of them keeping secrets, Mack brings him aboard Robert Gonzales' carrier to explain.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack joins the team while Fitz is struggling after his brain injury and becomes his closest friend, once throwing himself over Fitz to shield him from an explosion.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Later, as Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., Mack teams up with Jaco to rescue Fitz and Jemma from Izel.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack knocks out Lincoln Campbell aboard the Iliad when he finds him with Skye during the Inhuman attack.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: The two later work together at S.H.I.E.L.D., where Mack and Daisy ask Lincoln to guide a newly powered Inhuman through the change.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack and May become close friends on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: May stands behind Mack when he becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. In the fight against Sarge and Izel, she kills Izel and throws Mack Sarge's sword so he can finish Sarge.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Alphonso "Mack" Mackenzie is first sent by Robert Gonzales' rival S.H.I.E.L.D. to keep tabs on Phil Coulson, but the two come to trust each other deeply.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: When the team votes Mack in as Director, Coulson gives him his full support.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Piper volunteers for Mack and May's mission to kill Hive, and she helps carry the wounded Mack away after Daisy nearly kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Piper later serves under Mack once he becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mack and Coulson first track Robbie Reyes while hunting for Quake. Robbie later saves Mack and Fitz from the ghost Frederick, and when the Spirit of Vengeance briefly passes to Mack, Robbie stops him from burning a Watchdog alive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Mack keeps Robert Gonzales calm while the agents treat his wounded leg aboard the Iliad, then talks him into retaking the ship from Hydra. Afterward Mack serves in Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. and goes undercover in Coulson's team for him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Mack and Daisy run into Rosalind Price's ATCU team while hunting Lash, and Mack pulls a gun on Luther Banks when Banks tries to take Daisy, until Price calls him off. Mack keeps his doubts about the ATCU even as Coulson works with Price.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale ambushes Mack and Yo-Yo at a St. Louis aerospace facility, waiting until Yo-Yo uses her powers to save Mack and then slicing off Yo-Yo's arms with a chakram. Mack carries Yo-Yo out as Ruby lets them go.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: When Vin-Tak goes after Skye at the Playground, Mack steps into his way and tells him it is his fight now. The Kree warrior gets past him and Lance Hunter with ease.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Gargantos attacks America Chavez in New York City while hunting her for the Scarlet Witch.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Rintrah is at Kamar-Taj when Strange and Wong bring America there for protection, and he helps defend it from Wanda.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Stephen Strange protects America Chavez from Wanda across the multiverse and helps her learn to trust her powers. Afterward she trains at Kamar-Taj.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Wanda Maximoff hunts America to take her power to travel the multiverse. She nearly succeeds before America shows her what she has become.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Wong saves America Chavez from Gargantos in New York and helps protect her at Kamar-Taj.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Arthur Harrow serves as the avatar of the goddess Ammit and works to free her.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Khonshu fights Ammit in Cairo after she is freed, and helps seal her back inside a mortal body.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Layla fights Ammit's forces in Cairo as the Scarlet Scarab when Ammit is freed.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Marc Spector fights to stop Ammit from being freed. Once she is, Khonshu and the Moon Knight trap her again inside Harrow's body.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Ammit's rise is opposed by Taweret, whose avatar Layla El-Faouly fights Ammit.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Curtis Hoyle gives Amy and Frank a campervan to hide in while John Pilgrim hunts her, and Frank asks Curtis to look after her if anything happens to him.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Amy Bendix is a young con artist whom Frank protects from John Pilgrim and his employers. He takes her under his wing, and she becomes a daughter figure to him.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: John Pilgrim hunts Amy Bendix for the photos she holds and kidnaps her.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: The Schultzes want Amy Bendix dead because she holds photos of their son. She confronts them at their mansion.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Ana Jarvis is Edwin Jarvis' wife, and the two are devoted to each other.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: When Ana is badly hurt in an attack, Jarvis is consumed by the urge for revenge.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Ana Jarvis tries to stop Joseph Manfredi as he carries her unconscious friend Jason Wilkes to his car. Manfredi draws a gun on her, but Whitney Frost tells him to put it away.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Peggy Carter stays with Edwin and Ana Jarvis at Howard Stark's estate in Los Angeles, where Ana warmly takes her in and helps pick out her clothes. The two women become friends.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Whitney Frost shoots Ana Jarvis while raiding Howard Stark's estate to kidnap Jason Wilkes. Edwin later shoots Whitney twice in revenge, but the Zero Matter inside her heals the wounds.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Anatoly Ranskahov and his brother sit with Madame Gao as partners in Wilson Fisk's criminal alliance. When Anatoly reports that a masked man took out their men, Gao mocks them in Mandarin, wondering whether the man stole for himself or simply made fools of them.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Daredevil fights Anatoly Ranskahov and his brother's Russian mob in Hell's Kitchen.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Anatoly and Vladimir Ranskahov are brothers who lead the Russian mob together.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Anatoly Ranskahov is one of the Russian brothers in Fisk's alliance. When Anatoly bursts in on Fisk's date with Vanessa, Fisk beats him and kills him with a car door.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Andrew Garner, a psychologist and Melinda May's ex-husband, evaluates Skye after she gains her powers and helps her face the fears she keeps pushing aside.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: After Garner becomes the Inhuman Lash, he frees Daisy from Hive's control just before he is killed.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick and Grant Ward take Andrew Garner, now the Inhuman Lash, out of Endotex Labs, where he is locked in a containment module. Malick then holds him prisoner for Hydra.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hellfire returns from a beer run to find Lash attacking Hive at their hideout. He stabs Lash through the back with his flaming chain, killing him just after Lash frees Daisy.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Andrew Garner works with Jemma Simmons to help Skye after her powers emerge.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: He later counsels Jemma after she returns from Maveth. Once he becomes Lash and is held by Hydra, he talks her into letting him out of his containment module.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Andrew Garner evaluates Joey Gutierrez for Daisy's Secret Warriors and calls him unfit, since Joey cannot open a doorknob without melting it. Garner is reassessing Joey's improved control when Melinda May bursts in to confront him about being Lash.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lash hunts Lincoln Campbell, believing he has an uncontrollable dark side, and attacks him at the hospital where he works. Later the two former enemies work together to save Daisy Johnson from Hive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Andrew Garner is Melinda May's ex-husband, a psychologist who still loves her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: After he turns into the Inhuman Lash, May tries to stop him and blames herself for what happened.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Andrew Garner, May's ex-husband, secretly counsels Phil Coulson about his urge to carve alien writing.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: After Garner becomes Lash, Coulson tries to talk him down, but Lash insists that he is the cure.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: As Lash, Andrew Garner tears through the ATCU, and Rosalind Price shoots him several times in the chest without stopping him. Once he is contained, she joins Coulson and May in deciding to take him into ATCU custody.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Werner von Strucker enrolls in Andrew Garner's psychology class under a false name so Hydra can keep tabs on him. When Werner corners Garner on Grant Ward's orders to kill him, Garner turns into Lash and slaughters the Hydra agents, leaving Werner shaken.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Ayo and Aneka are lovers who serve together in the Dora Milaje. They fight side by side against the Talokanil and spend time together in Wakanda once the war ends.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: M'Baku and Aneka pull a grieving Shuri away from her mother's body after Namor's attack on Wakanda. They later fight side by side on the Sea Leopard, where Aneka answers M'Baku's prayer by vowing to take some Talokanil down with them.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Aneka flies with Shuri in the Sunbird during Namor's attack on Wakanda, until Namor slices the ship apart and sends them into the river. Aneka convinces Shuri to abandon the wreck, and they reach the Citadel to find Queen Ramonda has drowned.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Okoye once led Aneka in the Dora Milaje. After Okoye loses her rank, the two fight side by side as Midnight Angels.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Queen Ramonda leads Wakanda, and Aneka serves her as a captain in the Dora Milaje.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Aneka is a friend and protector of Princess Shuri. She gets Shuri to safety when Namor floods the city.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Angela del Toro confronts Connor Powell and the Anti-Vigilante Task Force and accuses them of killing her uncle.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hector Ayala is Angela del Toro's uncle. After his death she takes up his White Tiger suit and amulet.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Angela del Toro, part of Daredevil's resistance, helps free Jack Duquesne from Fisk's prison.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Angela del Toro teams up with Karen Page while trying to break her aunt out of the Fisk Freeport Complex.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Angela del Toro breaks into the Murdock & McDuffie office looking for Kirsten, and there she finds her uncle's White Tiger suit and amulet.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Matt Murdock was Angela's uncle's lawyer. He comforts her at the morgue after Hector's death and saves her from Muse.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Angela takes up her uncle's White Tiger amulet and fights beside Matt in his resistance against Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Muse abducts Angela del Toro while she investigates her uncle's death and starts draining her blood.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Angela del Toro is Soledad Ayala's niece and lives with her. After Hector's death, Soledad is left to look after Angela and visits her in the hospital when Muse nearly kills her.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: When Fisk's task force wrongly arrests Soledad, Angela sets out to break her free.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Angela del Toro takes up the White Tiger amulet and fights Mayor Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force, raiding his prison complex at Red Hook to free her imprisoned aunt Soledad.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Angie Kim and Brett Mahoney are NYPD colleagues who both turn against Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force. They stand together in the resistance outside the State Supreme Court during the Battle for New York.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Clark Pitts, known as Cherry, and Angie Kim are longtime NYPD detective partners and friends. She is at his retirement party at Josie's Bar when Bullseye attacks it.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Commissioner Phil Gallo is Angie Kim's superior. They brief Fisk together on the Muse killings.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Detective Angie Kim is one of the honest NYPD officers who stand with Matt's resistance against Fisk.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Angie Martinelli gets to know Edwin Jarvis through her friend Peggy Carter. Jarvis later moves both women into one of Howard Stark's penthouses, rent free.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Angie Martinelli is a waitress and aspiring actress who becomes Peggy Carter's close friend in New York. Peggy even invites her to live at Howard Stark's mansion.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Anitolov pulls a gun on Hope van Dyne when Sonny Burch exposes her at his restaurant, and she fights her way through him and the rest of Burch's men in her Wasp suit.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Anitolov is one of Sonny Burch's hired henchmen and pulls a gun on Hope van Dyne when Burch exposes her at his restaurant. He helps Burch chase Hank Pym's lab across San Francisco and is arrested alongside him.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Uzman and Anitolov are Sonny Burch's most menacing henchmen, and they argue with the X-Cons over whether Uzman's drug really counts as a truth serum. Later they chase down Hank Pym's lab together, boasting that they traffic in stolen technology and have killed many, many people.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Anne Weaver and Bobbi Morse sit together on Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. council, which sends Bobbi undercover into Coulson's team. Together they keep Fitz under watch and press Melinda May about Coulson's secret Theta Protocol.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Anne Weaver sits on Robert Gonzales' council, which debates capturing Skye after she gains her powers and wants the Inhumans treated as a threat. When Jiaying's Inhumans seize the Iliad, Skye and Coulson's team retake the ship and save Weaver.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Anne Weaver teaches Donnie Gill at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy of Science and Technology, where he is the youngest Sci-Tech student since Fitz and Simmons. She calls in Coulson's team over the freezing attacks, never suspecting that Donnie and his friend Seth are behind them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Anne Weaver teaches Jemma Simmons at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy of Science and Technology, where Jemma and Fitz become its youngest graduates.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Years later Weaver and Jemma work together at the Playground to secure dangerous alien artifacts like the Monolith.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Anne Weaver tries to convince Lance Hunter that Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. is about holding leaders accountable. Hunter mocks her democracy lesson and wants no part of it.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Anne Weaver teaches Fitz at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy of Science and Technology, where he and Jemma Simmons become its youngest graduates. Years later she invites them back to speak to her students.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: May joins Anne Weaver on Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. council. Weaver presses her for answers about Coulson's secret Theta Protocol, but May gives away very little.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Anne Weaver calls Coulson's team in to investigate the freezing attacks at her Academy.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Later, on Robert Gonzales' council, she votes against Coulson's plans and urges a strong show of force against the Inhumans, which Coulson refuses.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Anne Weaver joins Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. and sits on his council, backing the move against Coulson's faction. Together they try to convince Lance Hunter that Coulson has lost his mind to the alien writing.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Trip flies the Quinjet that picks up Bobbi Morse and Jemma Simmons when they leap off a Hydra rooftop to escape. Later he joins Bobbi, Lance Hunter, and May in tracking Grant Ward to Boston.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Trip and Skye become close friends on Coulson's team as they hunt Hydra after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Trip dies in the Kree city trying to pull Skye away from the Obelisk as the Terrigen Mist transforms her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: When Glenn Talbot's soldiers capture Coulson's team after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Trip insists they are not Hydra, and Talbot answers that to the world it is the same thing.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Trip and Grant Ward both trained under John Garrett, and they come to blows the first time their teams meet.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: When Ward sides with Garrett and HYDRA, Trip turns against him for good.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Antoine Triplett and Jemma Simmons become close friends, with a flirtation between them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Trip dies in the Kree city before anything can come of it.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett is Antoine Triplett's supervising officer and mentor, and the two work side by side as S.H.I.E.L.D. agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Trip is shocked when Garrett is unmasked as the Clairvoyant of HYDRA, and he turns against his old mentor.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Trip is set to take down Carl Creel with a sniper rifle, but Lance Hunter knocks him out so he can go after Creel himself. Even so, the two become friends fighting side by side on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Trip helps Fitz repair the Bus after the Hydra Uprising, and the two become friends even though Fitz sees him as a rival for Jemma's attention. Together they search John Garrett's base in Cuba and track the stolen Bus back to the United States.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Marcus Daniels, the Darkforce-wielding Blackout, escapes from the Fridge and goes after the cellist Audrey Nathan again. Trip and Coulson stop him for good, blasting him with concentrated light and Gamma power until he explodes.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Trip flies with Maria Hill in a jump jet to stop Grant Ward from escaping in the Bus. Hill stalls Ward long enough for Coulson to get aboard.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Antoine Triplett joins Coulson's team after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls and fights beside May on mission after mission. When three Hydra Quinjets attack, he follows her piloting instructions to the letter so they can slip away.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Antoine Triplett fights Deathlok while Mike Peterson is under the Clairvoyant's control, shocking him with tasers when Deathlok attacks him and John Garrett. Mike finally turns on Garrett, the man who controlled him all along.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Trip joins Phil Coulson's team after his own mentor John Garrett is exposed as Hydra, and he fights beside Coulson, even stealing an armored vehicle with him to break into Cybertek.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: To Coulson, Trip stands for the compassion, loyalty, and heart S.H.I.E.L.D. should be built on, and his death in the Kree city hits Coulson hard.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Trip helps guard Raina from Daniel Whitehall in Vancouver. He then follows Skye and Raina into the sealed Kree temple and dies trying to stop the Terrigen Mist from transforming them, and Skye later blames Raina for his death.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Victoria Hand puts Trip to work at the Hub with Jemma Simmons, consulting on Deathlok. When Hydra rises, she poses as Hydra and orders them to pledge loyalty or die, and Trip refuses, warning that one of her people will go down with them.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Anton Mogart is an antiquities collector Layla got to know in Madripoor. When she and Marc come to his estate under false names, seeking Ammit's ushabti, he turns his guards on them.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Anton Mogart, a collector of antiquities, has his guards attack Marc and Layla when they come to him for Ammit's ushabti.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ikaris stays loyal to Arishem, the Celestial who created the Eternals, and helps his plan move forward.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Arishem the Judge creates Kingo and the other Eternals to bring about the Emergence. Once it is stopped, he pulls Kingo into space along with Sersi and Phastos to judge humanity through their memories.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Arishem created the Deviants to clear Earth of predators, but they evolved beyond his control and turned on the Eternals.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Arishem the Judge creates Phastos, who later shouts that he lives for his family, not for Arishem. After the Emergence is stopped, Arishem pulls him into space with Sersi and Kingo to judge humanity.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Arishem the Judge creates Sersi and sends her to Earth, and after Ajak's death he reveals to her that the Eternals were made to bring about the Emergence. When Sersi stops it, Arishem takes her into space to judge whether humanity deserves to live.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Arnim Zola experiments on the captured Bucky Barnes in a HYDRA lab before Steve Rogers rescues him.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Zola's experiments on Bucky are revealed as the start of HYDRA's work turning him into the Winter Soldier.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: After Captain America captures Arnim Zola, Colonel Phillips interrogates him over a steak dinner and needles him for being the only Hydra man who did not take his cyanide pill. Zola gives up the location of the Red Skull's last base.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dum Dum Dugan and the Howling Commandos fight Arnim Zola's HYDRA across Europe and finally capture him in a raid on his train in the Alps. Zola's interrogation then points them to Red Skull's plan to attack America.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Arnim Zola is HYDRA's top scientist while Howard Stark builds weapons for the Allies, so the two stand on opposite sides of the war.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: After his capture, Zola is recruited into S.H.I.E.L.D., where Howard Stark is one of his superiors.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Jim Morita intercepts a HYDRA radio message that tells the Howling Commandos where Arnim Zola will be. The lead puts Zola on the train in the Alps where the team captures him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: After his capture, Johann Fennhoff shares a prison cell with Arnim Zola.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Natasha and Steve find Arnim Zola's mind stored in a computer bunker beneath Camp Lehigh. Zola reveals that Hydra has grown inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and stalls them while a missile destroys the base.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Peggy Carter drugs Arnim Zola and his guards at Castle Kaufmann to rescue Dr. Erskine from HYDRA.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: After the war Zola is brought into S.H.I.E.L.D., the agency Peggy co-founded, and secretly grows HYDRA inside it.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Arnim Zola is Johann Schmidt's chief scientist in HYDRA, and he builds the weapons Schmidt powers with the Tesseract.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Steve Rogers captures Arnim Zola on a HYDRA train in the Alps, the mission where Bucky falls.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Decades later Steve finds Zola's mind preserved in a computer at Camp Lehigh, where Zola boasts that HYDRA has been growing inside S.H.I.E.L.D. all along.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: The Howling Commandos spend the war tearing down HYDRA's operations, and they capture Arnim Zola in a raid on his train in the Alps. Bucky Barnes falls from the train during the mission and is presumed dead.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Arthur Harrow was Khonshu's avatar before Marc Spector. He left Khonshu to serve Ammit instead.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Layla confronts Arthur Harrow to get Steven back and later fights him and his disciples in Cairo.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Arthur Harrow is Khonshu's former avatar and leads the Disciples of Ammit. He shoots Marc dead, and Marc returns from the Duat to defeat him.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Att-Lass and Bron-Char serve with Carol on Starforce while she is known as Vers. When she learns the truth and turns against the Kree, they fight her on Earth and lose.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Att-Lass, Bron-Char and Korath serve together in Yon-Rogg's Starforce and trade friendly banter before missions. They raid Torfa as a team and later follow Yon-Rogg to Earth after Carol Danvers.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Att-Lass, Bron-Char and Minn-Erva are teammates in Yon-Rogg's Starforce. They raid Torfa together to rescue the Kree spy Soh-Larr and later follow Yon-Rogg to Earth to hunt down Carol Danvers.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Talos and his Skrulls ambush Att-Lass, Bron-Char and the rest of Starforce on Torfa when they come to rescue the Kree spy Soh-Larr. One of Talos' Skrulls even takes on Att-Lass' form.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Att-Lass and Bron-Char serve in Starforce under Yon-Rogg's command. They follow him on the mission to Torfa and again when he leads the team to Earth to hunt the Skrulls and bring Carol Danvers back.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor is the king of Talokan and Attuma is one of his top warriors. Attuma leads raids on the surface at Namor's command.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Attuma and Namora fight side by side as Namor's two lieutenants. Together they lead the Talokanil warriors in battle.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Attuma overpowers Okoye on a Cambridge bridge while the Talokanil seize Shuri and Riri Williams, mockingly handing her spear back and calling her a warrior. They meet again on the Sea Leopard, where Okoye, now a Midnight Angel, greets him with the same word in his own language before they fight.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Attuma leads the Talokan warriors with Namora when Namor sends them to Cambridge to capture Riri Williams. They carry her and Shuri back to Talokan as prisoners.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Attuma takes part in the capture of Shuri and Riri Williams in Boston and later fights Wakanda's forces led by Shuri.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Marcus Daniels is obsessed with cellist Audrey Nathan, whom he calls his light, and stalks her after escaping prison.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Audrey Nathan is a cellist and the great love of Phil Coulson's life. After his apparent death she believes he is gone, and he chooses not to tell her he survived.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Holden Holliway runs GLK&H, where Augustus Pugliese works as an attorney.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Augustus "Pug" Pugliese is Jennifer's colleague and friend at GLK&H. He goes undercover to expose the hate group Intelligencia for her.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Augustus Pugliese goes with Nikki Ramos to hire Luke Jacobson to make Jennifer's She-Hulk suit.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Augustus Pugliese is Nikki Ramos' friend and colleague at GLK&H. Together they hunt for Intelligencia.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Augustus Pugliese goes undercover in Intelligencia and helps unmask Todd Phelps as HulkKing.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Gorr the God Butcher kidnaps Axl and the other Asgardian children from New Asgard.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Axl is Heimdall's son and has inherited his father's all seeing powers. He uses them to reach Thor from Gorr's prison and lead the rescue to the captured children.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Axl uses his father's powers to contact Thor and Korg and tell them where Gorr is holding the children.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: When New Asgard starts training its children to fight, Sif personally teaches Axl, Heimdall's son, how to wield a sword.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Axl idolizes Thor. When Gorr kidnaps the Asgardian children, Axl uses his father's powers to reach Thor, and Thor lends the children his power to fight.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Valkyrie is the king of New Asgard, where Axl lives, and she fights to rescue him and the other kidnapped children.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ayesha hires the Guardians and hands Nebula over to Gamora as payment. After Rocket steals her batteries, Ayesha hunts them across space.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Years later Gamora, now riding with the Ravagers, unknowingly gives away the Guardians' location to Ayesha when she calls her outpost for a pickup.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Master Karja runs security for the High Evolutionary, and he works alongside Ayesha when she and Adam Warlock come to hunt the Guardians. Watching Adam blunder, he tells Ayesha her friend is a moron and that he has one of those too.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ayesha holds Nebula prisoner and then hands her over to the Guardians as payment.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ayesha hires the Guardians, then hunts them after Rocket steals her Anulax batteries.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Rocket steals Ayesha's Anulax batteries, and she hunts the Guardians for revenge.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ayesha hires the Ravagers to hunt down the Guardians after they rob the Sovereign. When Yondu backs out, Taserface leads a mutiny against him and sells Ayesha the Guardians' location.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary created Ayesha's Sovereign people. He kills Ayesha when she fails him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ayesha hires Yondu's Ravagers to capture the Guardians so she can kill them. Yondu double-crosses her and plans to sell her batteries instead, and her fleet later attacks him and the Guardians at Ego's planet.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Ayo helps free Bucky Barnes of his HYDRA programming during his stay in Wakanda, and the two grow close. She feels betrayed when Bucky helps Zemo escape, and she removes his vibranium arm with a single command.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Corvus Glaive breaks into Shuri's lab during the Battle of Wakanda and overpowers Ayo as she tries to protect Shuri and Vision.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Ayo easily beats John Walker in a fight over who gets custody of Helmut Zemo.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: When Erik Killmonger takes the throne, Ayo is bound to serve him for a time. Once T'Challa returns alive, she follows Okoye in turning on Killmonger and fights his forces at Mount Bashenga.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Ayo and the Dora Milaje fight Lemar Hoskins and John Walker over who gets custody of Helmut Zemo.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Ayo leads the Dora Milaje against Namor's forces when he attacks Wakanda and again on the Sea Leopard, where Namor slices her Royal Talon Fighter in half with his spear. The fighting only stops when Shuri and Namor agree to a truce.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye commands the Dora Milaje with Ayo at her side, and Ayo follows her when she rebels against Erik Killmonger.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: After Queen Ramonda strips Okoye of her rank, Ayo replaces her as general and has to stop her from leaving Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Ayo guards Queen Ramonda as one of the Dora Milaje. When Ramonda strips Okoye of her rank, Ayo becomes general and leads Wakanda's defenses under her.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ayo guards Shuri's lab while she works to remove the Mind Stone from Vision, holding off Corvus Glaive until he overpowers them.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Once Shuri becomes the new Black Panther, Ayo and the Dora Milaje follow her into battle against Talokan.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: T'Chaka recruits Ayo into the Dora Milaje and makes her his personal bodyguard. She travels with him to Vienna for the signing of the Sokovia Accords, where he is killed in the bombing.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Ayo serves in the Dora Milaje as T'Challa's security chief and nearly comes to blows with Natasha in Vienna to protect him.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: When Erik Killmonger takes the throne, Ayo is bound to serve him for a time. She returns to T'Challa's side once he comes back alive.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Ayo and W'Kabi both serve T'Challa until W'Kabi throws his support behind Erik Killmonger. In the battle that follows, W'Kabi's Border Tribe traps Ayo, Okoye, Nakia and Shuri behind energy shields and orders them to surrender.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Noni, by then a War Dogs leader, is B'Kai's superior while he spends nine years undercover in Troy.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Bakuto, Colleen's mentor and a leader of the Hand, shuts Claire out after saving Colleen from poison, driving off with Danny and Colleen without her.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Back from the dead, Bakuto holds his swords to Claire's neck at Midland Circle until Misty and Colleen stop him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Bakuto is Colleen Wing's sensei and the man who raised her in the Hand. She turns on him after learning what the Hand really is.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: The Hand brings Bakuto back to life, and Colleen faces her old sensei again and kills him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Bakuto helps Danny Rand defeat Madame Gao and offers to train him. Danny then learns Bakuto leads his own faction of the Hand.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Davos kills Bakuto in the middle of his duel with Colleen Wing, ending his hold over Danny Rand.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Elektra takes command of the Hand after she kills Alexandra, and Bakuto follows her.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Harold Meachum turns on the Hand and Bakuto, who then tries to kill him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Joy digs into the Hand's money in Rand Enterprises accounts to help her father strike at Bakuto. Bakuto later takes the Meachums hostage to force Danny to surrender, leaving Joy with a gunshot wound to the gut and refusing to take her to a hospital.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Luke Cage saves Colleen Wing from Bakuto, disarming him and throwing him across an alley just before he can execute her.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Madame Gao and Bakuto are rival leaders of the Hand who distrust each other.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Bakuto doubts Daredevil is a real threat when Murakami warns the Hand about him. When the Defenders storm Midland Circle, Matt Murdock fights Bakuto and Murakami at once and holds his own.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Bakuto cuts off Misty's arm during the battle with the Hand and tries to kill her.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Bakuto and Murakami are two of the five founders of the Hand. They fight Daredevil side by side when the Defenders storm Midland Circle to rescue Danny Rand.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Bakuto and Sowande are two of the five founders of the Hand. After Davos kills Bakuto, Sowande helps bring him back, and Bakuto is horrified when Sowande later dies.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward makes a deal with Bakuto's faction of the Hand, but the alliance falls apart.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall is a HYDRA leader and mentor to Wolfgang von Strucker.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dr. List is Wolfgang von Strucker's assistant in his HYDRA experiments.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Hale and Wolfgang von Strucker were classmates and rivals at the Hydra academy.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell and Wolfgang von Strucker were classmates at HYDRA's academy and later served HYDRA together.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Pietro Maximoff is one of Baron Strucker's HYDRA test subjects, and experiments with Loki's scepter give him his speed.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro, who volunteered for the experiments to strike back at the Avengers, fights for Strucker when they raid his HYDRA base in Sokovia.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Steve Rogers leads the Avengers' raid on Baron Strucker's HYDRA base in Sokovia to recover Loki's scepter. Strucker surrenders to the team and is taken prisoner.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Tony Stark and the Avengers raid Baron Strucker's HYDRA base in Sokovia to recover Loki's scepter. Iron Man breaks the base's energy shield, Strucker is captured, and Tony takes the scepter that leads him to build Ultron.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron breaks into Baron Strucker's cell after the Avengers capture him and learns that Ulysses Klaue has vibranium. Then he kills Strucker and paints the word 'PEACE' on the wall in his blood.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Baron Strucker does black-market business with the arms dealer Ulysses Klaue and knows about his vibranium. When Ultron comes to Strucker's cell, Strucker points him to Klaue's stockpile.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Wanda Maximoff is one of Baron Strucker's HYDRA test subjects, and experiments with Loki's scepter give her powers.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda, who volunteered for the experiments to strike back at the Avengers, fights for Strucker when they raid his HYDRA base in Sokovia.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Werner von Strucker is the son of Hydra leader Baron Wolfgang von Strucker.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Captain Ebo commands Basha in the War Dogs and is also his friend. When the Iron Fist Jorani follows Basha into Wakanda, the two argue over how to handle her, then cover for her together so she can get away.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Jorani, the Iron Fist, rescues Basha when his ship crashes and nurses him back to health in K'un-Lun. They fall for each other, then clash when his mission turns them against each other.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: BB is a young member of the Ryhno gang whom Danny clashes with at first. Davos later kills him.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos trains BB and the other Ryhno gang members in martial arts, then murders BB.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: BB Urich is the niece of reporter Ben Urich and is named after him. She suspects Wilson Fisk was behind his murder.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck Cashman is Fisk's fixer, and he controls BB Urich's access to the mayor.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Daniel Blake, a staffer for Mayor Fisk, falls for journalist BB Urich, and she befriends him as her inside source at City Hall. He pushes her hard to change her Daredevil story, but the two stay close.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: BB keeps warning Daniel, now deputy mayor, that Fisk's empire will come crashing down. After he is murdered, she exposes the people behind it.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
