stages.text: BB Urich keeps trying to get Commissioner Phil Gallo to talk about Fisk. Eventually he opens up to her about the Anti-Vigilante Task Force.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: BB Urich, niece of Karen's late mentor Ben Urich, works with Karen in the resistance against Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mitchell Ellison employs BB Urich at the New York Bulletin, the paper where her uncle Ben worked.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: BB Urich interviews Fisk for her online show and gives him exposure, while secretly working to take him down.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: In her final broadcast BB reveals the Fisk organization's part in Daniel Blake's murder, helping turn the city against him.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ben is Phastos' husband, and together they raise their son Jack in Chicago. Ben convinces Phastos to rejoin the Eternals.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: When Sersi comes to recruit his husband Phastos, Ben welcomes her and talks Phastos into joining her.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Ben Grimm dotes on his best friend's baby son Franklin and helps protect him from Galactus.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Ben Grimm fights Galactus alongside the Fantastic Four to protect Earth and Franklin.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: H.E.R.B.I.E. is the Fantastic Four's robot helper, who cooks dinner alongside Ben and Johnny. When Ben trips over a new baby gate while reading about childcare, he yells at H.E.R.B.I.E. for it.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Ben Grimm is Johnny's best friend and teammate in the Fantastic Four, and they trade jokes constantly.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Rachel Rozman is a teacher in Ben's old Yancy Street neighborhood, and the two take a liking to each other.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Ben Grimm meets Reed Richards in college and becomes his lifelong best friend. He joins Reed aboard the Excelsior on the mission that gives them their powers, and the two fight side by side as the Fantastic Four.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: The Silver Surfer announces Earth's doom and clashes with Ben and the team before she turns against Galactus.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Ben Grimm and Sue Storm are close friends who gain their powers together aboard the Excelsior. At home, Sue breaks up his scuffles with her brother Johnny by wrapping their heads in force fields until they stop.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Ben Urich questions Christian Blake and his partner Carl Hoffman while digging into the Russian mob. Blake mocks his fading career and tells him the world is a shitty place and he can quote him on it.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Ben Urich is a veteran reporter who teaches Karen how to investigate and works with her to expose Fisk, until Fisk kills him.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Ben Urich is a veteran reporter who works with Matt's firm and Karen to expose Wilson Fisk, until Fisk kills him.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Mitchell Ellison is Ben Urich's editor at the New York Bulletin and an old friend, though he pushes Ben toward stories that sell.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Reporter Ben Urich digs into Fisk's past and visits his mother. Fisk kills him in his own home.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Buck Cashman is Wilson Fisk's loyal fixer and the one who reports Benjamin Poindexter's escape from Rikers. When Poindexter later takes a shot at Fisk, Buck shields his boss and takes the bullet himself.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Benjamin Poindexter, the hitman Bullseye, shoots up the retirement party of Clark Pitts, known as Cherry, at Josie's Bar and kills Foggy Nelson there.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Benjamin Poindexter, the hitman Bullseye, kills Father Lantom when he attacks Clinton Church.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Felix Manning handles Benjamin Poindexter for Fisk and finds him the blackmail tools Fisk needs.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Benjamin Poindexter, the hitman Bullseye, shoots Foggy dead outside Josie's Bar.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Wilson Fisk sends Benjamin Poindexter, disguised as Daredevil, to kill Jasper Evans before Evans can talk to the New York Bulletin. Poindexter tracks him down and shoots him dead.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Benjamin Poindexter, the hitman Bullseye, hunts Karen for Fisk. He attacks the New York Bulletin and Clinton Church trying to kill her.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: When Fisk orders Governor Marge McCaffrey killed, Benjamin Poindexter, the hitman Bullseye, is the one who saves her life.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Benjamin Poindexter, the hitman Bullseye, impersonates Daredevil for Wilson Fisk and fights Matt at Clinton Church.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Years later Poindexter murders Matt's best friend Foggy Nelson outside Josie's Bar.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: After Poindexter is wounded attacking the Fisks, Matt takes him into custody and has Soledad Ayala treat him. Then he lets him go free so he can save Governor Marge McCaffrey from Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Under pressure from Fisk's people, Melvin Potter makes the Daredevil suit that Benjamin Poindexter wears to impersonate Daredevil.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Benjamin Poindexter storms the New York Bulletin and tries to kill Mitchell Ellison while hunting Karen.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles of the CIA recruits Benjamin Poindexter after Wilson Fisk's time as mayor comes to an end. He takes Poindexter out of New York to work for the agency.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ray Nadeem considers fellow FBI agent Benjamin Poindexter a friend. Poindexter, now Bullseye, later kills him on Fisk's orders.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Benjamin Poindexter is a former friend of the Nadeem family who kills Seema's husband Ray.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Tammy Hattley is Benjamin Poindexter's superior at the FBI, and she assigns him to guard Wilson Fisk. She soon suspects he lied in his report about the shootout with the Albanians.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Vanessa Fisk has Benjamin Poindexter freed and hires him to kill Foggy Nelson and keep the Red Hook port secret. Poindexter later turns on the Fisks and attacks their ball at Gracie Mansion.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Poindexter keeps hunting the Fisks, and Vanessa dies from his attack at Fogwell's Gym, though she wounds him.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Fisk recruits FBI agent Benjamin Poindexter and turns him into his weapon, sending him out in a fake Daredevil suit. Poindexter later turns on Fisk, and Fisk breaks his back.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Years later Poindexter comes after Fisk and Vanessa to make up for his past, and he attacks the mayor's ball at Gracie Mansion.

stages.title: Item 47
stages.text: Felix Blake and Jasper Sitwell hunt down Bennie and Claire after they use a Chitauri gun to rob banks. Instead of locking them up, S.H.I.E.L.D. hires them, and Claire becomes Blake's assistant, much to his displeasure.

stages.title: Item 47
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell tracks down Bennie and Claire after they rob banks with a Chitauri gun. Then he recruits them into S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Beth Quinn is a bartender who has a one-night stand with Frank and then becomes his friend.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Bethany is Ward's sponsor in his addiction recovery group. They sleep together, which gets in the way of his recovery.

stages.title: The Daily Bugle
stages.text: J. Jonah Jameson hires Betty Brant as an intern to run The Daily Bugle's social videos. He cuts in whenever she speaks too kindly of Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Julius Dell is Betty Brant's teacher at Midtown. She interviews him for the school news.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Betty Brant is Liz Allan's best friend at Midtown High and helps her decorate for homecoming. When Liz has to leave the school after her father's arrest, she hugs Betty goodbye.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Betty and Ned coin the name Mysterio after Quentin Beck's staged rescue in Venice, and he later appears to save their Ferris wheel from the Fire Elemental in Prague. In London, Beck's drones hunt Betty and her friends through the Tower of London, where she and MJ trick one into firing at a suit of armor.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Ned Leeds and Betty Brant date during the class trip to Europe, then break up.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Betty Brant is Peter's classmate at Midtown High, where she co-hosts the school news and often reports on Spider-Man. He saves her and the decathlon team in the Washington Monument elevator.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Roger Harrington teaches Betty and seats her next to Ned on the flight to Europe, where their romance begins.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Betty Ross and Bruce Banner are scientists who fall in love before the gamma accident. Her father, General Ross, hunts Bruce relentlessly.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Emil Blonsky shoves Betty Ross aside to knock out Bruce Banner when her father's soldiers capture him. Later, as the Abomination, he tears through Harlem while Betty watches Bruce fight him as the Hulk.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Leonard Samson is a psychiatrist who dates Betty Ross while Bruce Banner is gone.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross is Betty Ross' father. His hunt for Bruce Banner drives a wedge between them for years.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wilson Fisk is Bill Fisk's son. Bill beat his wife and pushed young Wilson to be cruel, until Wilson killed him with a hammer to protect his mother.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Bill Foster takes in Ghost after her father's death and raises her like a daughter.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Bill Foster worked with Hank Pym at S.H.I.E.L.D. on Project Goliath until their disagreements ended the project. Years later, Foster secretly helps Ghost, who needs Hank's research to cure herself.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Bill Foster works against Hope van Dyne to help Ghost, then sides with her in the end.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Bill Foster worked alongside Janet van Dyne and Hank Pym at S.H.I.E.L.D. years ago.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Bill Foster helps Ghost take Scott Lang captive, then helps him in the end.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Bill Metzger captured and experimented on Jean's sister Sara, who died in his care. Jean hunts him for answers and almost kills him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Bill Metzger, director of Damage Control, enlists Spider-Man to stop Jean Grey's attacks on his agency and lies to him about why she wants revenge. When Jean later holds glass shards to Metzger's face, Spider-Man talks her down and saves his life.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Billy Koenig greets Skye and the team at the Playground, where she first mistakes him for his late brother Eric. He keeps the base running for her and Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Billy and Eric Koenig are brothers who both worked on S.H.I.E.L.D.'s early Life Model Decoy program and later guard Nick Fury's secret bases. Billy keeps running the Playground after Grant Ward murders Eric.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Billy Koenig keeps fighting Hydra after Grant Ward murders his brother Eric, and he draws his gun when Ward comes to take Skye.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe has the Watchdogs kidnap Billy Koenig and pretends to be a fellow captive so he can learn where the Darkhold is hidden. When Billy refuses to talk, Radcliffe gets inside his head with a virtual reality headset.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Nick Fury trusts Billy Koenig to run the Playground, one of his secret bases. After pulling Jemma Simmons and the comatose Fitz out of the sea, Fury brings them to Billy's base to recover.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: When Nick Fury makes Phil Coulson the new Director, Billy Koenig hands him the Playground, telling him that what little they have is his. Billy keeps the base running for Coulson.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Eddie is the boyfriend of William Kaplan, the life Billy Maximoff wakes up in after a car crash. Billy confesses to Eddie that he is not entirely William and cannot remember who he was before.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Billy lives as Jeff Kaplan's son William after his soul enters William's body during a car crash. Jeff raises him as his own child.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Jennifer Kale, a potions witch, walks the Witches' Road with Billy in Agatha's coven. She first knows him only as "Teen" and they become friends along the way.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Lilia Calderu, a divination witch, walks the Witches' Road with Billy in Agatha's coven. Her reading of his split life line hints at who he really is.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Monica Rambeau jumps in front of Billy and Tommy and stops Tyler Hayward's bullets during the battle in Westview.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Billy is the nephew of Pietro Maximoff, Wanda's twin brother who died in Sokovia.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Billy lives as Rebecca Kaplan's son William after his soul enters William's body during a car crash. She raises him as her own child.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Rio Vidal travels the Witches' Road with Billy Maximoff, hoping Agatha will hand him over to her. Billy refuses to surrender, and Rio lets him go.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Sharon Davis, a former Westview resident, joins Agatha's coven on the Witches' Road alongside Billy.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Billy and Tommy are the twin sons Wanda Maximoff creates with her magic in Westview, and they grow up side by side inside the Hex.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Years after the Hex falls, Billy finds Tommy's lost soul and places it in the body of a drowned boy, Thomas Shepherd.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tyler Hayward opens fire on Billy and Tommy Maximoff, and Monica Rambeau steps in to save them.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Billy is the son of Wanda and the Vision she recreates inside the Westview Hex.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Billy Maximoff is one of the twin sons Wanda Maximoff creates with her magic in Westview. When she brings down the hex, she has to let him go.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Brett Mahoney leads the police hunt for Billy Russo after Russo escapes custody.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Billy Russo was Curtis Hoyle's friend from the war, but he turns on Curtis and tries to kill him.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Billy Russo helps William Rawlins hunt David Lieberman, the analyst who leaked the truth about Operation Cerberus.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Billy Russo and Homeland Security agent Dinah Madani become lovers, while he secretly works against her investigation into Operation Cerberus.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: When Dinah confronts him, Billy shoots her in the head. She survives, and from then on she wants him dead.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Billy Russo is Frank's best friend and brother in arms from the Marines.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Billy is revealed to have secretly betrayed Frank to help William Rawlins, and Frank scars his face on the carousel where his family died.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Billy escapes from the hospital, and Frank hunts him down and kills him.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Krista Dumont is Billy Russo's therapist after his injuries. She falls in love with him and joins his crimes.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Billy Russo charms Sam Stein during Anvil's training session for Homeland Security. When Stein catches a masked Russo during a shootout and unmasks him, Russo stabs him to death before he can tell anyone.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Billy Russo was close to the Castle family as Frank's friend. He was secretly part of the plot behind their deaths.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: William Rawlins led Operation Cerberus, where Billy Russo served. Billy later works with him to cover up their crimes.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Biscuits and Bonnie are cousins in Tamaha, and Biscuits lets it slip over the radio that Maya is back in town. When Bonnie and their grandmother go missing, he tries to warn Maya, and the reunited family later shares lunch together.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Chula Battiest is Biscuits's grandmother, and she lends him her pickup truck while she plans the powwow. He wrecks it on a job for his cousin Maya and spends days rebuilding it as a monster truck.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Biscuits is Maya's cousin, who runs a pawn shop in Tamaha and helps her after she comes home.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Taloa Lopez is Biscuits's aunt, the mother of his cousin Maya.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Blake Tower is a rival lawyer whom Foggy challenges in the race for District Attorney.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Blake Tower is a Manhattan prosecutor who later becomes District Attorney, sometimes opposing Matt's firm and sometimes working with it.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Blake Tower serves under District Attorney Samantha Reyes and succeeds her after her death.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Bucky Barnes is among the team trying to contain Bob Reynolds when Valentina's Sentry project unleashes his powers, and Bob tosses him aside with ease. Once the team pulls Bob back from the Void, he joins Bucky on the New Avengers.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Ghost and the others find Bob Reynolds in Valentina's vault and escape with him. When he becomes the Void, Ghost and the Thunderbolts face him and help pull him out of his darkness.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: John Walker meets Bob Reynolds in the O.X.E. vault. Bob, as Sentry, beats Walker badly, but in the end Walker stands with him on the New Avengers.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Mel identifies Bob Reynolds as a Sentry test subject who survived, which tells Valentina her project worked. Once Bob's powers spin out of control, Mel is nearly one of his victims.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine experiments on Bob Reynolds in her Sentry program and then tries to control him.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Yelena Belova bonds with Bob Reynolds over their shared emptiness. She walks into his darkness as the Void and helps pull him out.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi Morse becomes a friend to Skye after joining Coulson's team and brings her supplies to get through quarantine. When Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. moves against Skye's powers, Bobbi leads the agents sent to bring her in.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi Morse goes undercover inside HYDRA as head of security for Daniel Whitehall. She uses the post to spy on him for S.H.I.E.L.D. and to watch over Jemma Simmons.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi Morse works with General Glenn Talbot as S.H.I.E.L.D. hunts down Hydra and helps hand Hydra prisoners over to his custody. She argues with him over Carl Creel, whom Talbot defends despite Creel's record.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Grant Ward and Kara Palamas kidnap Bobbi, blaming her for the brainwashing Kara suffered in Hydra. Ward tortures her by playing on her fear of needles until Lance Hunter rescues her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi Morse and Isabelle Hartley are close friends, and Bobbi introduces her husband Lance Hunter to Isabelle and her sister Jane. During the Hydra Uprising, Bobbi and Isabelle fight side by side to retake the Iliad.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi Morse watches over Jemma Simmons while Jemma is undercover inside HYDRA. Afterward the two become close friends.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Bobbi Morse greets Joey Gutierrez at the Playground after S.H.I.E.L.D. rescues him and explains he is being kept in a module for his own safety. Later, when the team is cornered, she cheers on his idea to seal the doors with his powers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi Morse respects Kara Palamas from their missions together, but intelligence Bobbi passes to HYDRA while undercover leads to Kara's capture and brainwashing. Kara later teams up with Grant Ward to kidnap and torture Bobbi.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Kebo, Grant Ward's Hydra enforcer, scoffs that he has taken down men three times Bobbi's size. She tells him she has experience and kills him when she and May storm the penthouse where he is torturing Werner von Strucker.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lance Hunter and Bobbi Morse are exes who were once married. They bicker constantly but fall back in love.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: When they are captured in Russia, Bobbi and Hunter let themselves be disavowed to protect S.H.I.E.L.D., and they leave the agency together.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi Morse brings Jemma Simmons home safely from her undercover mission in Hydra and becomes a friend to Fitz as he adjusts.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Melinda May scouted Bobbi Morse at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy and calls her the strongest recruit she ever saw. They become friends on Coulson's team, though May catches Bobbi letting Robert Gonzales' agents into the Playground, and Bobbi escapes her with a flip through a window.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: During the Hydra Uprising, Nick Fury gives Bobbi Morse a secret order to blow up the aircraft carrier Iliad so Hydra cannot take its weapons. She chooses to fight for the ship instead and helps take it back.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Phil Coulson sends Bobbi Morse undercover inside Hydra to watch over Jemma Simmons, then welcomes her onto his team. She is secretly spying on him for Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D., but she ends up one of Coulson's most loyal agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi Morse rescues Robert Gonzales during the battle for the Iliad and stays loyal to his S.H.I.E.L.D. afterward. He sends her to spy on Coulson's team, and she recommends the raid on Coulson's base.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Bobbi Morse tracks an ATCU weapon back to Rosalind Price and spies on her agency with Lance Hunter. When Giyera nearly beats Bobbi, Price has Luther Banks help her and Hunter escape.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: While undercover in HYDRA, Bobbi Morse works alongside Sunil Bakshi under Daniel Whitehall. After S.H.I.E.L.D. captures Bakshi, Bobbi is the one who questions him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Colombian police officer Victor Ramon has his Inhuman officer Lucio paralyze Bobbi Morse and Lance Hunter, then hauls them in for questioning. He greets Bobbi as beautiful and tells her Hunter's fate depends on her answers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Vin-Tak, a Kree warrior hunting Skye, fights Bobbi Morse twice. When he comes after Skye, Bobbi tells him she doesn't love fighting but will fight for one of her people.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Bobby Fish meets Claire Temple when she reconnects with Luke over lunch, and he steps away so the two can catch up. Later, she and Bobby talk at the barbershop about the daughter he left behind.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: D.W. Griffith and Bobby Fish are friends who keep Pop's barbershop running as Luke grows famous, selling his merchandise and chasing out fans who show up to film him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Bobby Fish is a regular at Pop's barber shop, and he stays a loyal friend to Luke.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Bobby Fish met Pop over chess games in Marcus Garvey Park and kept visiting when Pop got too busy, becoming a fixture at the barbershop. After Pop's death, Bobby helps Luke carry on the way Pop would have wanted.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett spends his days in Harlem playing chess with his old friend Bobby Fish at Pop's Barber Shop.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Chula Battiest is Bonnie's grandmother, and she holds young Bonnie back as Maya's family leaves Tamaha. Years later, Kingpin kidnaps the two of them together to lure Maya out.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Bonnie is Maya Lopez's cousin. She reconnects with Maya when Maya returns to Tamaha.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Taloa Lopez is Bonnie's aunt, and Bonnie is camping in a tent with her cousin Maya the night Taloa leaves for the store and dies in a car crash.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Wilson Fisk has his men kidnap Bonnie, Maya Lopez's cousin, along with Chula Battiest at the Choctaw powwow to use them against Maya. Bonnie is forced to translate for Fisk until Maya rescues her.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: E.D.I.T.H. nearly kills Brad Davis with a drone strike after Peter accidentally marks him as a target.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Julius Dell is Brad Davis' teacher at Midtown and chaperones his class trip to Europe.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Brad Davis has a crush on MJ during the class trip to Europe and ends up seated beside her on the flight, leaving Peter jealous. MJ never returns his interest and falls for Peter instead.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Brad Davis competes with Peter Parker for Michelle Jones' attention on their class trip. When Brad gets a compromising photo of Peter, Peter nearly has E.D.I.T.H. strike him by mistake.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Roger Harrington is Brad Davis' teacher at Midtown and chaperones his class trip to Europe.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Brett Mahoney lets Carl Hoffman into Christian Blake's hospital room, unaware Carl has been ordered to kill his partner. When Carl later decides to come clean, Daredevil tells him to turn himself in to Mahoney because he can be trusted.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Brett Mahoney and Christian Blake work out of the same precinct, and when Blake is shot during a raid, Mahoney guards his hospital room. He lets Carl Hoffman in to visit, not knowing Carl has come to kill him.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Connor Powell is a fellow NYPD officer whom Brett Mahoney calls out for forgetting that the police serve the people. Powell goes on to join Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force, which puts him at odds with Mahoney.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Curtis Hoyle and Brett Mahoney end up working together, even though Curtis once fired a shot inches from Mahoney's head to stop him arresting Frank Castle. Curtis hands Anderson Schultz over to Mahoney, who lets him walk free, and later calls him to the church where Billy Russo lies dead.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Detective Brett Mahoney and Homeland Security agent Dinah Madani butt heads over jurisdiction while chasing Frank Castle and Billy Russo. Mahoney questions her after Frank's attack on Stan Ori, and she keeps working around him to hunt Russo herself.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Brett Mahoney is Foggy's childhood friend and a reliable contact on the NYPD.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Detective Brett Mahoney hunts Frank Castle, the Punisher, for his killings across the city.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: When John Pilgrim runs Mahoney's ambulance off a bridge while he is taking Frank to prison, Frank cuts him free from the burning wreck and saves his life.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Brett Mahoney looks after Grotto when the Punisher marks him for death, laying out his options and putting him into witness protection. The Punisher gets to Grotto anyway.

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: John Pilgrim hunts Frank Castle while Brett Mahoney is driving him to prison in an ambulance. Pilgrim runs them off a bridge, badly hurting both men.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Brett Mahoney is an NYPD friend who helps Karen and her friends from inside the department.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Brett Mahoney is an NYPD officer who knows Matt and grows into a quiet ally of Daredevil on the force.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Detective Oscar Clemons works alongside Brett Mahoney at the 15th Precinct and teaches him to give witnesses as little information as possible. When Kilgrave takes over the station, a controlled Mahoney turns his gun on Clemons.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Brett Mahoney is the police officer who arrests Fisk after Daredevil defeats him.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik Gelden is Brianna's brother, and he confronted their father after realizing he had abused her. When Gregory Sallinger becomes a threat, Erik pays off her pimp and pulls her somewhere safe.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Malcolm takes in Brianna Gelden to protect her from Gregory Sallinger, and she later shows up at his door asking for a second chance. He lets her stay, and the two become lovers.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Brock Rumlow leads the HYDRA strike team that fights alongside the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes, while he is under HYDRA's control. Together they hunt Steve Rogers through Washington.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jack Rollins serves under Brock Rumlow on S.H.I.E.L.D.'s STRIKE team, and both are secretly HYDRA. When HYDRA moves against Steve Rogers, Rollins joins Rumlow in the elevator ambush meant to bring him down.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Brock Rumlow is a S.H.I.E.L.D. strike leader secretly loyal to Hydra. Maria Hill frees Steve, Natasha and Sam from his custody before he can execute them, and at the Triskelion she spots him heading for the World Security Council and sends Sam after him.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Brock Rumlow serves with Natasha Romanoff on S.H.I.E.L.D. missions, then tries to kill her once HYDRA is exposed.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson fights Brock Rumlow's HYDRA strike team when S.H.I.E.L.D. falls.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Years later, as Crossbones, Rumlow fights Sam again in Lagos.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When Rumlow storms the Triskelion control room and orders the Insight launch, Sharon pulls her gun on him and refuses to back down. He warns her that she has picked the wrong side.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Brock Rumlow leads the S.H.I.E.L.D. strike team that works under Steve Rogers. When S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, he reveals he has been HYDRA all along and turns on Steve.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Scarred and calling himself Crossbones, Rumlow tries to kill Steve with a suicide bomb in Lagos.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Wanda and the Avengers track Crossbones to Lagos. When he sets off his suicide vest, she tries to carry the blast away, but it explodes beside a building, killing him and several bystanders.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Bruce Banner fights Cull Obsidian in Greenwich Village and in Wakanda, where he kills him.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Elaine Walters is Bruce Banner's aunt and the mother of his cousin Jennifer Walters.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Emil Blonsky is a soldier who takes the super-soldier serum and Banner's blood to fight the Hulk. He becomes the Abomination and nearly kills Bruce.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: The Hulk wrestles Hela's giant wolf Fenris on the Bifrost to protect the fleeing Asgardians, and drags it over the edge into the sea.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: When Jean Grey takes control of the Hulk, Frank Castle helps Spider-Man fight him off and opens fire on Bruce Banner's rampaging form.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Heimdall saves Bruce Banner after Thanos beats the Hulk aboard the Statesman, using the last of his power to send him to Earth. Thanos kills Heimdall for it.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Jean Grey takes over Bruce Banner and forces him to become the Hulk. She uses him to tear through Damage Control's headquarters.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jennifer Walters is Bruce Banner's cousin. After his blood gets into her body in a car crash, she gains Hulk powers of her own, and he trains her to control them.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Leonard Samson is the psychiatrist dating Betty Ross when Bruce Banner comes back into her life. He lets Bruce stay in their home, but uneasy about him, he tips off General Ross, which leads to the battle at Culver University.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: The Hulk ends Loki's rampage in Stark Tower by smashing him into the floor and calling him a puny god.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: When they meet again on Sakaar, Loki is less than thrilled to see the Hulk, but the two end up on the same side in the fight to save Asgard's people.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris Walters is Bruce Banner's uncle by marriage and the father of his cousin Jennifer Walters.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff recruits Bruce Banner in Calcutta to help S.H.I.E.L.D. find the Tesseract, and she barely escapes the Hulk when he breaks loose on the Helicarrier.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Natasha can calm the Hulk with a lullaby, and she and Bruce fall for each other. After the battle in Sokovia, the Hulk flies off alone and they are torn apart.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Nick Fury brings Bruce Banner aboard the Helicarrier to track the Tesseract, with a cell built to hold the Hulk standing ready. Bruce confronts Fury when he learns S.H.I.E.L.D. is using the Tesseract to build weapons.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Bruce Banner and Rocket travel to New Asgard together to pull a grieving Thor back into the Avengers for the Time Heist.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Samuel Sterns is "Mr. Blue," the scientist who tries to cure Bruce Banner. He goes on to become a villain.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Bruce Banner runs the first time travel test on Scott Lang, accidentally turning him into a teenager, a baby and an old man before bringing him back. They then go on the Time Heist together.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Skaar is Bruce Banner's son, whom Bruce brings home to meet the family.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Bruce Banner fights beside Steve Rogers as one of the first Avengers, and in New York Steve trusts him to unleash the Hulk on cue.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they plan the Time Heist together, and Steve volunteers to return the Stones that Bruce used to undo the Snap.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: As Surtur sets Asgard ablaze, the Hulk leaps onto his face and pounds away at him. Thor calls him off, because letting Surtur finish Ragnarok is the only way to stop Hela.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross hunts Bruce Banner for years and treats him as a weapon to be controlled.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos beats the Hulk aboard the Asgardian refugee ship, and afterward Bruce Banner cannot get the Hulk to come out.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years after the Snap, Bruce wears the Stark Gauntlet to bring back everyone Thanos snapped away.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: The Grandmaster keeps the Hulk as his prized champion on Sakaar, the undefeated star of his Contest of Champions. The Hulk walks away from that life to escape with Thor.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: When the Hulk breaks loose on the Helicarrier he fights Thor, but they end up side by side as Avengers in the Battle of New York.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Thor finds the Hulk fighting as the Grandmaster's champion on Sakaar, and the two teammates become real friends.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner bond as fellow scientists aboard the Helicarrier and become close friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Together they build Ultron from the code they find in Loki's scepter, and after Ultron turns on them they create Vision.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they work together on the Time Heist, and Bruce wears the gauntlet Tony helps build to undo the Snap.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Bruce Banner helps Tony Stark build Ultron from the code they find in Loki's scepter, hoping it will protect the world. Ultron turns on its makers, and Bruce fights to stop him, rescuing Natasha from Ultron's base in Sokovia.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Valkyrie and the Hulk become drinking buddies while living on Sakaar. She and Bruce Banner escape together with Thor and fight Hela's forces on Asgard.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Doctor Doom appears in Bruce Banner's hidden lab, forces him into his Hulk form and teleports away with him.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Bruce Banner helps Tony Stark upload J.A.R.V.I.S. into the synthetic body that becomes Vision. Vision then fights beside him as a fellow Avenger.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda Maximoff uses her powers on Bruce Banner in Johannesburg, sending the Hulk on a rampage that Tony has to stop with the Hulkbuster. She later joins the Avengers alongside him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Bruce Banner crash lands in the Sanctum Sanctorum to warn of Thanos' coming, where Wong and Stephen Strange take him in.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Bruno Carrelli is Kamala's best friend. He builds her gadgets, studies her powers and has feelings for her.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Bruno Carrelli helps Kamran escape Damage Control, and the two become friends.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Bruno helps Kamala protect Kamran from his mother Najma and fights the Clandestines with her.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia Bahadir and Bruno Carrelli are friends through Kamala and help her fight Damage Control.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sadie Deever's Damage Control agents hunt Bruno, Kamala and Kamran in Jersey City.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sheikh Abdullah hides Bruno and Kamran from Damage Control at the mosque and gives them caps to disguise themselves.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Buck Cashman guns down the marshals protecting Christofi Savva and then shoots Savva dead.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Buck Cashman supervises Daniel Blake as Blake rises on Fisk's staff. When Blake refuses to give up BB Urich as the leaker, Cashman kills him.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck Cashman digs up Phil Gallo's secret mistress and son, which Fisk uses to threaten him.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck Cashman brings Heather Glenn high-profile couples therapy clients on behalf of the Fisks.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: James Wesley recruits Buck Cashman into Fisk's service, and the two are friends.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck Cashman is Fisk's enforcer. He is sent to kill Matt in the hospital, but Matt escapes.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Buck Cashman shoots two of Mr. Charles's associates and threatens him when the Fisks turn on the CIA.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck Cashman works for Vanessa while she runs the empire and stays at the Fisks' side as their bodyguard.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck Cashman is a former soldier brought in by James Wesley. He becomes Fisk's loyal enforcer and bodyguard, and later works on his mayoral staff.
